title: Our Place By The Sea Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Our Place By The Sea is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 652 FOREST STREETWelcome to Our Place by the Sea in Seaside, FloridaWelcome to Our Place by the Sea, a charming stand-alone single-family vacation home in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Designed for up to four guests, this thoughtfully appointed retreat features multiple outdoor living spaces, a large private yard, and private parking—a rare and valuable offering in Seaside. Spacious and welcoming, this home lives larger than expected and is destined to become a favorite coastal escape for couples or small families.Inviting Outdoor Living & Private YardGuests are greeted by a screened front porch featuring an outdoor swing and rocking chairs—an ideal spot for morning coffee or unwinding after a beach day. Additional outdoor living includes two generous porches, multiple decks, and an open-air tower, all surrounded by the privacy of a large fenced yard. With outdoor dining, Adirondack seating, and a charcoal grill, this home seamlessly blends indoor comfort with Seaside’s signature outdoor lifestyle.Comfortable Living Spaces for Relaxing TogetherInide, the spacious living room offers a large flat-screen TV with a Sonos sound bar, making it perfect for family movie nights or relaxed evenings in. A queen sleeper sofa provides additional sleeping accommodations when needed. The open layout allows for easy flow between the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating a comfortable and inviting gathering space.Renovated Kitchen & Dining AreaThe fully renovated kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and bar seating for two, making meal prep both functional and stylish. Adjacent to the kitchen, the dining area includes a round table with seating for four to six, ideal for shared meals or game nights. Double doors open to the rear deck, leading to outdoor dining and quiet backyard seating.Private Primary Suite with Porch AccessUpstairs, the king primary bedroom suite offers a peaceful retreat with a large flat-screen TV, ample storage, and an ensuite bathroom. The renovated bathroom features a glass-enclosed tub and shower combination, generous counter space, and additional storage. Step through double doors onto your private open-air porch, furnished with rocking chairs—perfect for reading, relaxing, or enjoying a sunset nightcap.Open-Air Tower with Seaside & Gulf ViewsJust off the primary suite, a ship’s ladder leads to the open-air tower, one of the home’s most unique features. With Adirondack bar seating for two, this elevated escape offers beautiful views of Seaside’s rooftops and slight Gulf views, along with unforgettable sunsets. It’s the ideal spot for a quiet evening overlooking town.Thoughtful Amenities for a Seamless StayAdditional amenities include an enclosed outdoor shower, outdoor seating areas, a stackable washer and dryer, and designated private parking directly in front of the home. Every detail has been considered to make your stay in Seaside effortless and enjoyable.Your Seaside, Florida Coastal EscapeWhether you’re seeking a relaxing beach getaway or a walkable Seaside retreat filled with charm, Our Place by the Sea delivers a truly memorable experience. Come unwind, reconnect, and enjoy the timeless beauty of Seaside, Florida—your coastal reset awaits.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,131 square feet (1,700 square feet including porches and tower — home lives large)Seaside Private Residential Beach at West Ruskin Pavilion352 yards / 5-minute walk to the beach and 5-minute walk to downtown Seaside, FLEnclosed outdoor showerOutdoor dining for six on the rear deckCharcoal grillMedia in every bedroom with Sonos sound barStackable washer and dryerAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking pass issued for one-bedroom homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. No pets allowedSTR23-002393
